features.feature: CHK-001 Bind delivery-check artifacts to reviewed material
features.covered_by: Checklist requires delivery_check_set to record current materialHash/headHash and include material binding in integrity hash; plan steps 1-2 extend DeliveryCheckData/signing and record current material binding; verification covers fresh current-material acceptance, metadata-only non-stale behavior, and missing/tampered binding rejection.
features.source: checklist_get CHK-001; plan_get Chosen Contract/Implementation Steps

features.feature: CHK-002 Fail closed when material changes after delivery-check
features.covered_by: Checklist requires DONE oracle, machine guard, and lifecycle readiness to classify post-review material drift as stale_delivery_check; plan step 3 adds a shared freshness predicate consumed by those gates; verification covers material-drift stale blocking, docsPromise behavior, and tamper failure.

features.feature: CHK-003 Add focused regression smoke and baseline result artifact
features.covered_by: Checklist requires a focused delivery-check freshness smoke and derived baseline item 5 result artifact; plan steps 4-6 add the smoke, wire fast focus in lattice.config.json, and add a derived B-d321 baseline result without modifying immutable v1; verification requires authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false in the result.

features.feature: CHK-004 Verify process-fact registry and artifact contract coverage for delivery-check binding
features.covered_by: Checklist requires either registry/artifact contract coverage or explicit proof existing delivery-check L4 contract covers the new binding; understanding records current process-fact coverage is artifact/provenance level while field-level binding belongs in DeliveryCheckData, integrity hash, and focused smoke coverage; scope contract protects process-fact registry files and plan verifies the existing artifact contract path with scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.
features.source: checklist_get CHK-004; understanding_get facts; scope_contract_show protectedFiles; plan_get Verification

features.excluded_by: Plan Out Of Scope says no Authority Server changes; CHK-002 excludes external server dependency; baseline non-goals exclude Authority Server business logic.
features.source: plan_get Out Of Scope; checklist_get CHK-002; docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-workflow-efficiency-baseline.md

features.excluded_by: Plan Out Of Scope says no production or receipt-backed claims; CHK-001 excludes treating local evidence as Authority or production proof; baseline non-goals exclude treating local/non-authority evidence as Authority proof.
features.source: plan_get Out Of Scope; checklist_get CHK-001; docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-workflow-efficiency-baseline.md

features.excluded_by: Plan Out Of Scope says no delivery reviewer role relaxation; CHK-001 excludes changing delivery reviewer role ownership or main-agent self-signing; decision principles preserve delivery reviewer role separation.
